svg.title: Figure 5-2: the risk worksheet
svg.desc: A worksheet with one line per rated row of the risk assessment, grouped by hazard: the situation and zone, the S, F and P ratings with the higher class tinted, the required Performance Level in a coloured chip, the measures of the three ISO 12100 steps as chips coloured by whether each exists today, the residual-risk class as a lettered dot, and a bar of how many of the row's measures are in place.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 5-2 The risk worksheet: every rated row from hazard to residual, and what exists today

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Identification and estimation from §4 and §5, the measures of each ISO 12100 step and the residual class from WP-C-05 §5; each measure coloured by its §6 state on any build today.

svg.text: S, F, P: tinted at the higher class (S2, F2, P2). The rationale of each rating is the §5 table; the residual text and the verification are WP-C-05 §5 and WP-C-03-risk-register.xlsx.
